description: Add a todo — for the agent's OWN work list (or a person's personal reminder they asked for). Something a HUMAN must do, decide or answer goes to delegate_to_user (with an = that person), not here: todos for others were ignored for days. Required: title. Optional: user_id (defaults to caller), agent_id (omit = the user's own list), notes, due_at (ISO), priority ('low'|'normal'|'high'), lead_id (link to a lead), timezone. Times without a UTC offset are read as wall-clock time in the caller's timezone (pass timezone, an IANA name, to override) — so '14:00' means 14:00 where the user is, not 14:00 UTC. ESCALATION: pass escalate_at AND escalate_to to hand the task to someone else automatically once that moment passes while it is still open — the handover is recorded in the audit trail with both names. Both are needed: a deadline without a target escalates into nothing, which looks like a process but is not one. Returns { todo_id, url } — url is the todo's page in the app. Called by an AGENT: if an open todo on the same list from the last 24 h names the same DN, the same lead or (almost) the same title, nothing is created and that todo comes back with dublette:true and a hint (append news with update_todo; trotzdem:true creates anyway).

brain_id.description: Agent brain (category) this todo belongs to.

escalate_at.description: ISO time. If the task is still open then, it is handed to escalate_to. Deliberately NOT the same as due_at: 'by when should it be done' and 'from when must someone else look' are different questions.

escalate_to.description: user_id that takes over. Escalating to the current owner does nothing — that is a loop, not an escalation.

trotzdem.description: Agents only: create even if an open todo on the same list from the last 24 h names the same DN, lead or (almost) the same title — otherwise that todo is returned with dublette:true.

name: create_todo
